facts.fact: The article's abstract names the absence of an integrated national digital strategy as one of four structural constraints on Morocco's public-service digitalisation; it rests on OECD reviews of 2018 and 2019 and gives no date for the absence, so the published date is used.

note: Abstract only. The absence statement names no system, so class is empty; Maroc Numeric 2013 is named with no description of its scope.
